title: Page 69
transc:
Ft. Monroe Apr 19. 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
for Bruno unity when shelter wilson was in charge of
panama Bureau I required for plank purple pacific spartans zebra
He requested me to send inspectors which I did laugh
days since zodiac I have not received a single spafford
unity It is all important that I should have them
my panama has important work to do zebra will you
not please make an extra effort to furnish me at
least plug promise forth with zodiac my inspectors have been
sent away from growl to inspect spartans I know not
where Webster Knox Rebecca weather cloudy cold & very windy
Geo D Sheldon


Washington Apr 20 1864 
Geo D Sheldon F Monroe
April harsh Fanny for Knocks please wrangle Persia
Maxim Wicks in person Tulip the pacific Bureau
Can not at present fill your requisitions &
those torch opal torch Attica Jupiter will decide
which shall have the preference youth ivory horn
Thos T Eckert


Maj Eckert Di  Ft Monroe April 20 1864
for Italy unity weather received zebra maxim writes he will
not be able to white for some days Pedlar from
the tenor of his letter & the tarquin delays he
speaks of I should judge it would be feeble days
zodiac He did not receive his orders till the flag
instant Youth Knave Hannah this is all to fill up
Geo D Sheldon
